zh-Hant.title: 和諧食譜 Kindcipe
zh-Hant.subtitle: 一鍵配好三餸一湯，家人零時差
zh-Hant.description:
【和諧食譜 Kindcipe】一家人，一餐飯，一句「食咩好？」就開始。

無論你係返工好攰、要照顧一家大細，定係想同屋企人／姐姐夾好每日晚餐，Kindcipe 幫你由「諗食咩」到「買齊餸」一次搞掂。

◆ 一鍵三餸一湯
揀返人數同口味，AI 即刻幫你配好一餐（三餸一湯，湯種按你時間：滾湯、煲湯、老火湯）。

◆ 匯入任何食譜
見到 Instagram、YouTube、小紅書、Facebook 嘅食譜？複製連結或直接分享入 App，AI 自動整理成食材同步驟。

◆ 週餐單 + 家庭同步
一家人（同姐姐）共用同一個廚房，一齊睇餐單、一齊確認，減少溝通誤會。

◆ 自動買餸清單
餐單一撳自動生成購物清單，分好食材類別，仲可以記錄價格同格價。

◆ 食譜庫 + 收藏
官方 AI 食譜、你自己嘅食譜、KOL 食譜，一個地方搵得返。

◆ 多語言
繁體中文、English、Filipino、Bahasa Indonesia。

— 訂閱 —
免費版可用基本功能（可與 1 位家人共用）。升級 Pro 可解鎖更多匯入、AI 出餐同更多家庭成員。

訂閱會透過 App Store 收取；可隨時喺 Apple ID 設定取消。
私隱政策：https://kindcipe.com/privacy/
支援：https://kindcipe.com/support/
zh-Hant.promoText: 今晚食咩唔再頭痕。一鍵生成三餸一湯，自動整合買餸清單，同屋企人、姐姐同步，煮飯從此有商有量。

en-US.title: Kindcipe
en-US.subtitle: 3 dishes + 1 soup, one tap
en-US.description:
Kindcipe — plan dinner together, without the daily "what's for dinner?" debate.

For busy families and domestic helpers, Kindcipe turns "what should we eat?" into a ready set of 3 dishes + 1 soup, a shared weekly menu, and an automatic shopping list.

◆ One-tap 3 dishes + 1 soup
Pick servings and taste; AI builds a balanced meal (soup style matches your time).

◆ Import any recipe
Instagram, YouTube, Xiaohongshu or Facebook? Copy the link or share it into the app — AI extracts ingredients and steps.

◆ Shared weekly menu
Your whole family (and your helper) share one kitchen: view, confirm and stay in sync.

◆ Auto shopping list
Turn your menu into a categorised shopping list, with prices and comparisons.

◆ Recipe library
Official AI recipes, your own recipes and creator recipes — all in one place.

◆ Languages
Traditional Chinese, English, Filipino, Bahasa Indonesia.

— Subscription —
Free plan includes core features (share with 1 family member). Pro unlocks more imports, AI meal planning and more members.

Subscriptions are billed via the App Store; cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy: https://kindcipe.com/privacy/
Support: https://kindcipe.com/support/
en-US.promoText: Stop asking "what's for dinner?". Generate 3 dishes + 1 soup, auto-build your shopping list, and stay in sync with your family and helper.
